title: Inference KPI telemetry pipeline: Prometheus + OpenTelemetry design
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: design and deliver a robust metrics collection pipeline for inference-specific KPIs (token throughput, P95/P99 latency, KV cache hit-rate, batching utilization, per-model GPU utilization) that works across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Scope includes: instrumentation guidelines, metric names/labels, Prometheus scraping strategy, OpenTelemetry collector topology, low-cardinality relabel rules, exemplar generation for trace correlation, remote_write to long-term store (Cortex/Thanos), Grafana dashboard templates, and alert rule proposals. Deliverables: 1) design doc with diagrams and relabel configs, 2) runtime instrumentation changes (SDK + exporters), 3) OTel collector configs and helm charts, 4) Grafana panels + alert rules, 5) test plan and rollout checklist.
comments: 2026-01-28: Kickoff meeting — aligned on primary KPIs: token_rate_total, inference_request_count, inference_latency_seconds (histogram), kv_cache_hit_ratio, batching_utilization_percentage. Agreed to use prometheus-style names with 'redwood_inference_' prefix.

2026-02-05: Prototype shows P99 tail latency spikes correlated with low batching_utilization. Instrumentation change required to emit batch_size distribution with histogram buckets tuned for 1-64 tokens.

2026-02-18: Decision: adopt OpenTelemetry SDK for new runtime components (C++ and Go) to enable exemplars and unified traces+metrics, while keeping Prometheus scrape endpoints for legacy services to avoid mass rollouts.

2026-02-23: Tradeoff discussion: exemplars are valuable for linking a P99 sample to a trace, but increase payload size. Will enable exemplars only on sampling path (1% by default) and expose config to increase for canaries.

2026-02-28: Design note — label schema: model_name, model_variant, deployment_mode, region, shard, host_id, gpu_type. Strict limit: max 5 high-cardinality labels on any metric; user_id and request_id must never be added as labels.
2026-03-04: PR opened for collector config and relabel rules: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability-config/pull/72. Includes relabel_configs to drop request_id and normalize model names.

2026-03-07: QA run in staging: remote_write to cortex-staging succeeded for 24h retention; observed cardinality spike on model_variant due to mis-encoded build tags — fixed via normalize_model relabel action.

2026-03-09: UX review for Grafana panels: grouped panels by KPI (latency, throughput, cost). Suggested adding 'cost per 1M tokens' panel via token_cost_rate computed from token_rate and model_price label.
2026-03-10: Action items: (1) finalize SDK exemplar API and sampling config, (2) add unit tests for histogram buckets, (3) update runbook with incident play for sudden KV cache hit-rate degradation.
Pending: verify privacy constraints for Private deployments when enabling exemplars (trace payloads may carry request metadata).
acceptance_criteria: Instrumentation emits agreed metric names and label set for all runtime variants
Prometheus + OTel collector ingest pipeline deployed in staging and writing to remote long-term store
Grafana dashboard renders P50/P95/P99 latency panels and shows exemplar trace links for sampled P99s
Alerting rules in staging: P99 latency increase > 50% for 5m, kv_cache_hit_ratio < 70% for 10m, batching_utilization < 20% for 5m
No high-cardinality labels present in production metrics (confirmed via cardinality audit)
notes: Use histograms for latency and batch_size to enable quantiles in Prometheus; avoid summaries because they are not cluster-aggregatable.
Keep metric cardinality bounded: use relabel_configs and OTel processors to drop/aggregate high-cardinality fields (e.g., group user_id by hashing into buckets if needed).
Remote write: plan to send metrics to Cortex in prod; retention tiering will be configured by SLO — high-resolution metrics for 30d, rolled-up rates for 90d+.
Exemplars: emit exemplar with trace_id and span_id on histogram observations for P95+/P99+, sampling default 1% adjustable per deployment_mode.
Instrumentation libraries: provide reference wrappers in runtime-go and runtime-cpp to standardize label sets and histogram boundaries.
For Private deployments: offer a configuration toggle to disable exemplars and remote_write by default to satisfy air-gapped requirements.
